name: grimorium
description: Gerenciador de demandas e relatórios diários com IA

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:local: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --open"
